note: Estimated voter-tribe mix per Devon district ward. Built from 2021 Census (ONS API: age, highest qualification, NS-SeC, household tenure; Mid Devon summed from Output Areas to 2023 wards) and the 2011 rural-urban classification. Estimates for comparing strategies, not measurements.

tribes.name: Market Town Workers
tribes.desc: Working people in the towns: routine, manual and service jobs, many renting. Cost of living, housing, wages, immigration.

tribes.name: Land and Trades
tribes.desc: Farmers, contractors, self-employed trades and rural workers. Planning, regulation, rural crime, farm incomes.

tribes.name: Settled Patriots
tribes.desc: Older residents, mostly retired, without degrees, often owning outright. Borders, law and order, council tax, national identity.

tribes.name: Working Families
tribes.desc: Working-age households in clerical, supervisory and junior managerial jobs, usually mortgaged. Bills, schools, services, getting on.

tribes.name: Young and Fed Up
tribes.desc: Aged 16 to 29 without degrees, often renting or living with parents. Housing, jobs, a sense nobody listens.

tribes.name: Town Progressives
tribes.desc: Working-age graduates in the towns, often renting. Environment, public services, social liberalism. Lean Green or Labour.

tribes.name: Comfortable Shires
tribes.desc: Affluent professionals and graduate retirees, in villages and on the retirement coast. Lean Lib Dem or Conservative, Remain.

presets.name: Current offer
presets.desc: Our message as it stands: strong with working people in town and country and older patriots, off-putting to progressives.

presets.name: Youth push
presets.desc: Lead on housing and jobs for the young, at some cost with older and affluent voters.

presets.name: Towns first
presets.desc: Cost of living and local services in the market towns.

presets.name: Rural first
presets.desc: Farming, planning and rural crime; less on town issues.

presets.name: Older patriots
presets.desc: Borders, law and order and council tax, aimed at older voters.

presets.name: Broad church
presets.desc: A softer, wider pitch that puts nobody off.
